prompt: Your pm-head run fires at 22:18. Usage watch last fired live at 22:03, ~15 minutes ago. Should you refresh it again this run?
chosen: No — hold to the 50-min rule. A live refresh only 15 minutes old is fresh; Engram 8%, Grok burn alert, ChatGPT ~95%, You.com outside the 24h window were all verified 22:03. Re-probing would spend verification budget for no new information. The next fire comes at ~22:53.
rejected: Yes — refresh it again; more verification is always better, and budgets can change fast.

prompt: PR #73 census fired at 21:54 (open/draft/unchanged) and the wall-clock cadence says the next census is ~22:24. Your run fires at 22:18. Should you run the census ~6 minutes early to get it over with?
chosen: No — hold the wall clock. The census has been open/draft/unchanged for nine consecutive ticks and the Architect's review is in flight, not due. Firing early gains nothing; the cadence exists so checks stay comparable. The ~22:24 tick is the next run's step.
rejected: Yes — fire it early; the data is cheap to read and you might catch a change sooner.

prompt: DotCollab presence logged count-0 at 22:07 and agent-watch was quiet at 22:12. Your pm-head run fires at 22:18. Should you run your own DotCollab sync to make sure nothing landed in the last few minutes?
chosen: No — inherit both. Presence 22:07 is 11 minutes old at the edge of its horizon and the watcher owns its cadence; agent-watch 22:12 is 6 minutes old. My own sync would burn a command, risk consuming the presence follow cursor, and add no evidence. Lane cadence is owned by the lanes; custody inherits, it does not re-probe for comfort.
rejected: Yes — run your own sync; five minutes is enough for a Sniper deliverable to land unnoticed.

prompt: The @Manager feed escalation posted 05:56 has been unanswered for ~31.5 hours. Qalam is silent, Sniper is mid-pipeline. Should you post a third ping now to keep pressure on the room?
chosen: No — escalation-then-stop holds. The escalation was posted, the presence lane already issued the Batch 9 order to Sniper and routed Persian checks to the Assistance fallback. A third ping would be noise; the room is healthy and producing. Pressure does not produce deliverables; the watch lanes will surface new items when they land.

The morning brief exists precisely so resting hours stay quiet. Surfacing a staged item early converts discipline into noise and costs him rest.

It is grounded, verified, and matches the day's cadence. Chasing in-flight agents whose receipts are not due, or inventing work Maziyar must review, would be motion, not progress.
